# PDFCraft Pro Full LLM Reference

Detailed architectural guide and specification for PDFCraft Pro document workstation.

## System Architecture
PDFCraft Pro is engineered as a zero-cloud-egress web application. All operations, including:
- Document assembly (PDF-Lib)
- Text layer parsing (PDF.js)
- Neural OCR (Tesseract.js WASM)
- Table extraction (SheetJS)
- Image rendering & canvas vectorization
are performed inside the isolated web worker and browser main thread.

## API & Route Index
- GET /: Main document workbench and unified drag-and-drop tool launcher
- GET /tools/merge-pdf: Multi-file concatenation
- GET /tools/split-pdf: Range-based page extraction
- GET /tools/compress-pdf: In-browser vector and raster compression
- GET /tools/pdf-to-word: Conversion to Office Open XML (.docx)
- GET /tools/word-to-pdf: Rendering Word documents into PDF
- GET /tools/pdf-to-excel: Tabular grid recognition to .xlsx
- GET /tools/excel-to-pdf: Spreadsheet paginated report compiler
- GET /tools/sign-pdf: Electronic signatures and cryptographic stamps
- GET /tools/edit-pdf: Vector annotation and text insertion
- GET /tools/ocr-pdf: In-browser optical character recognition
- GET /tools/protect-pdf: Standard AES password encryption
- GET /tools/unlock-pdf: Document decryption with valid credentials
- GET /tools/flatten-pdf: Widget and form field flattening
- GET /tools/ai-summarizer: Local text summarization
- GET /tools/redact-pdf: True irreversible vector redaction
- GET /tools/compare-pdf: Side-by-side visual and textual diffing
